buildCommand: node scripts/sync-transactions.js && node scripts/update-sw-version.js && next build
ignoreCommand: git log -1|grep -qE '\[(skip ci|vercel skip)\]'||{ B=$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA;[ "$B" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ]&&exit 1;git cat-file -e "$B^{commit}" 2>/dev/null||B=HEAD^;git diff --quiet "$B" HEAD -- . ':!*.test.*' ':!*.spec.*' 2>/dev/null||exit 1;}
